title: Abduction memory returns 25 years later and is checked by remote viewers

tellings.quote: And when she said that 25 years later after the event, it all came flooding back [sighs]

plain: A memory of being abducted came rushing back to the former Army sergeant Lyn Buchanan 25 years after the event, when a woman said something that set it off, and he then had it checked by the remote viewers in his unit, people trained to try to perceive distant events with the mind. Buchanan tells Michels this happened in the late 1980s: "when she said that 25 years later after the event, it all came flooding back." If the check held up, it would mean a buried abduction memory could be confirmed by others.
